rows.en: Roger!
Right, we're backing up MAT! Understood?
Leave it to me, Cap!
What…!? You were so down in the dumps just a minute ago!
Looks like there's no time for chatting…
Defeat all Gigants!
Defeat the Planet-Dwelling Monster Jamila!
Defeat the Planet-Dwelling Monster Jamila and all Kelbaans!
Defeat the Phosphor Monster Granadas!
Defeat the Phosphor Monster Granadas and all Kelbaans!
Ide is defeated
Hideki Go or Fumio Kishida is defeated
Fumio Kishida is defeated

Nngh… That Cubrican has the nerve to come crawling back!

Gatezone!! Order the Chap Soldiers to punish Cubrican at once!

General Jark, please wait!

Cubrican is the strongest warrior in my Kaima Robot Battalion! I beg you, give him one more chance.

I will not!

Even the strongest warrior, if he cannot complete his mission, deserves nothing but punishment!

…!?

That's… one of the Crisis Empire's Kaima Robots that Kotaro told us about?

Why? Is it being attacked by its own comrades…?

Huh!?

That's… one of the Crisis Empire's Kaima Robots Kotaro mentioned?

How come? Why's it getting attacked by its own side?
Stop it, Chaps!! I'm a higher-ranked warrior than you!
By order of General Jark, we will destroy you!!
General Jark's…!?
Nngh… I won't let myself be destroyed without a fight!
Who's there?
Cubrican!? What do you want with me?
Lady Maribaron… please give me one more chance!
A chance?
I swear I'll defeat RX!
Hmph…
Lady Maribaron!! Look at this!
That one!? Isn't she one of Kotaro Minami's friends?
Yes… I thought she'd make good bait to lure him out…

Very well… Cubrican!

If you manage to defeat RX… I shall soothe General Jark's anger for you!
I am most grateful…
I have a scheme… Lend me your ear.
Yes, ma'am!
Understood?
Yes, ma'am…
We've got trouble!! [HERO4] got carried off by those Crisis guys!!

What!? [HERO4] was kidnapped?

Taki… this is no time for jokes! [HERO4], of all people, getting kidnapped… there's no way that could happen!
Still think I'm joking?
This is…!?
The charm I gave [HERO4]…? Then… it's true?
Yeah… I wish it was a joke. It was lying near the scene!
Then… [HERO4] is…?
Damn it… Crisis! Why the hell would they take [HERO4]?
I'm the one they're after… They must have kidnapped [HERO4] as bait to lure me out!
Wait!! [HERO2]! Leave this to me!
Kotaro's right, [HERO2]! If you do something rash, [HERO4]'s life will be in danger! Leave this to Kotaro and wait!
It'll be all right! I'll bring [HERO4] back, I promise! Trust me!!

…………

All right… I'm counting on you, Kotaro!
Right…
We've got trouble!! [HERO4] got carried off by those Crisis guys!!

Huh!? [HERO4] got kidnapped?

Taki, quit joking around! Kidnap [HERO4]…? Only someone with seriously weird taste would do that!
And that someone with weird taste is the Crisis Empire…
The Crisis Empire…!?
Then… it's true?
Yeah… I wish it was a joke.
I'm the one they're after… They must have kidnapped [HERO4] as bait to lure me out!
Wait!! [HERO2]! Leave this to me!
But…
Kotaro's right, [HERO2]! If you do something rash, [HERO4]'s life will be in danger! Leave this to Kotaro and wait!
It'll be all right! I'll bring [HERO4] back, I promise! Trust me!!

…………

Understood. Kotaro, please bring her back!
Yeah…
Cubrican!!

I've been waiting for you! Kotaro Minami! No, Kamen Rider BLACK RX! I'll pay you back for last time!

Unless you defeat me… you'll never get the hostage back!
Bring it on!! I'll defeat you right here!
I am the child of the sun! Kamen Rider BLACK RX!!
Nngh… you insolent pest!! I'll smash you to pieces!!

Ohohohoho… Kotaro Minami, Cubrican! Fight to your hearts' content!

I'll enjoy watching to see which of you is left standing!

Ohohohoho… RX, Cubrican! Fight to your hearts' content!

I'll enjoy watching to see which of you is left standing!

Maribaron! Are you going back on your promise to me?

Weren't Kaima Robots co-developed by our Crisis Empire and that Naager outfit supposed to come back me up?
Silence, Cubrican!! General Jark's orders are absolute!
Damn yooou!!
"Naager…? Have they joined hands with the Crisis Empire too?"
Nngh… That Maribaron…!

Cubrican! It looks like… we've both been set up!

How about it? Why not release the hostage and put a stop to this pointless fight?

Shut up, Kotarooo!! It's your fault I ended up like this!

You're the one I'll smash, no matter what!! If you want to save this hostage, you'll have to beat me! Here I come!!

uncertain: U13387/U13388: 船捜独獣 read as 棲星怪獣 (Jamila's title); rendered 'Planet-Dwelling Monster Jamila' (not in glossary).
U13389/U13390: 薄光独獣 read as 燐光怪獣; glossary 'Phosphor Monster Granadas'.
U13388/U13390: 'all Kelbaans' assumes several Kelbaan units on the map (異て = 全て).
U13406-U13419: Cubrican addresses Maribaron as 様; 'Lady Maribaron' / 'Yes, ma'am'.
U13435/U13436: HERO2's joke about [HERO4] ('only someone with weird taste') and Taki's comeback kept at full teasing strength.
U13445: 'please bring her back' adds the object for the bare お願いします; the request is HERO2 asking Kotaro.

new_names.why: title not in glossary (ジャミラ=Jamila is)
